title: Extend the Safety Horizon for Intelligent Transportation Systems through Semantic-Aware Cooperative Perception
abstract: arXiv:2608.14603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cooperative perception enables vehicles and infrastructure to exchange sensor data via Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication, extending sensing coverage beyond occlusions and mitigating blind spots. While critical for autonomous driving and safety, practical deployments often rely on bandwidth-efficient late fusion. Recently, intermediate fusion has emerged as a promising approach for an optimal bandwidth-accuracy trade-off. translated_title: 通过语义感知协同感知扩展智能交通系统的安全视界
translated_abstract: 协同感知使车辆和基础设施能够通过车联网（V2X）通信交换传感器数据，从而将感知范围扩展到遮挡物之外并减少盲区。尽管这对自动驾驶和安全性至关重要，但实际部署通常依赖于带宽高效的后融合方法。近年来，中间融合作为带宽-精度权衡的最优方案崭露头角。然而，在密集城市环境中，累积带宽需求可能压垮网络容量，从而危及安全关键的协作式智能交通系统（C-ITS）功能。为解决这些问题，本文提出了分层多尺度语义感知协同感知（HMS-SCP），这是一种用于协同感知中任务导向语义通信的鲁棒抗噪且带宽高效的框架。HMS-SCP利用空间重要性预测器来识别任务相关区域，并优化数据传输。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为HMS-SCP的带宽高效且抗噪的语义感知协同感知框架，通过空间重要性预测和分层多尺度设计，在密集城市环境中扩展智能交通系统的安全视界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HMS-SCP, a bandwidth-efficient and noise-resilient semantic-aware cooperative perception framework that extends the safety horizon for intelligent transportation systems in dense urban environments via spatial importance prediction and hierarchical multi-scale design.
